Mongo._comment: Connection string is a SECRET. Provide via user-secrets or the Mongo__ConnectionString environment variable — never commit it.

Jwt._comment: This API is a RESOURCE server only — it VALIDATES tokens issued by the central identity provider (admin.keshavsingh.in / id.keshavsingh.in). Issuer/Audience/SigningKey MUST match the IdP exactly. SigningKey comes from the Jwt__SigningKey environment variable, never this file.

_comment_payments: Non-secret payout details used only to render a UPI 'pay to' deep link/QR for contributions (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm and every other UPI app all honour the same upi:// intent — there is no per-app integration). No card/bank credentials are ever handled by this API; a human always reconciles the UPI reference number the contributor pastes in before a Contribution is marked Verified.
_comment_storage: Where an admin-uploaded UPI QR image is kept. Provider 'Local' (default) writes to disk — fine for a single instance, lost on redeploy on most hosts. For production, set Storage__Provider=S3 plus Storage__S3__ServiceUrl/Bucket/AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey as environment variables (Cloudflare R2: ServiceUrl is https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com) — same package/shape as admin/backend already uses, so admin's existing R2 account/bucket can be reused with these same credentials if you'd rather not create a second one. Credentials are secrets: never commit them here.
